## What's free

Free PostgreSQL, MySQL and Valkey: single node, 1 CPU, 1 GB RAM, 1 GB storage (PostgreSQL/MySQL)

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://aiven.io/pricing> before relying on this.

## Plan

- `modules/<service>`: the managed resources, sized to the free tier by default
- `stack/`: the root module whose outputs expose connection details (sensitive values marked `sensitive`)
